note: Wire the 2025+ depth-chart feed into is_starter and starter_out_at_position; map snapshots to real weeks by as-of join on kickoff.
justification: Correctness, not accuracy. The 2025 feed changed schema and only build_depth_chart_features was updated, so starter_out_at_position was a constant 0.0 across 2025 and 100% null in the 2026 predict frame, is_starter was 95% null (one August snapshot stamped week=1), and the three ix_starter_x_opp_td_* interactions fell 24x against 2024. Five features in the locked set, 1.17% of xgb gain. Paired on identical folds the fix is a wash: anytime_td xgb Top-1 -0.27pp pooled (-1.06pp on 2025, +5/-8 games, p=0.58), Top-3 -0.27pp; first_td ensemble Top-1 -0.27pp (p=0.51). Both inside the measured seed bands (0.55pp Top-1, 0.63pp Top-3), so no guard is tripped, but it does not clear the improvement gate either and is not claimed to. Kept because the served 2026 board was reading an August depth chart and a null injury flag.
